font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
